milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the stone brick chapel and face the purple stained glass windows. Target is set to the center of the glass cluster at spawn-relative [7, 2, 7], with max_distance=5 (player must be within 5 blocks) and facing_tolerance=60 degrees (player must be looking toward the glass). This models 'player can see the purple stained glass' without requiring them to stand on an exact spot.
